create_lagrangian_form_linear: create a Linear Lagrangian form and initialize its parameters with a PRNG key and shape
create_lagrangian_form_linear_exp: create a LinearExp Lagrangian form with linear and exponential penalty terms
build_lagrangian_form_from_config: build a Lagrangian form instance from a ConfigDict specifying name and kwargs
apply_lagrangian_form: apply a Lagrangian form to batched input tensors with lagrange parameters and step number
test_lagrangian_form_init_params: test initializing Lagrangian form parameters with zeros or random values
